<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="uz">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>128-25-guruh talabalari</title>
<style>
:root{--green:#176b48;--light:#f4f8f4;--red:#c62828;--gold:#f0b429;--ink:#18312a}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#e8f7ed,#fff8df);color:var(--ink);min-height:100vh}
main{width:min(900px,94%);margin:0 auto;padding:22px 0 40px}
.panel{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dce8dd;border-radius:22px;padding:clamp(18px,4vw,34px);box-shadow:0 12px 35px #164d3214}
.center{text-align:center}
h1{font-size:clamp(27px,5vw,43px);margin:8px 0 14px;color:var(--green)}
h2{margin:8px 0 14px}
.muted{color:#60746a;line-height:1.6}
button{border:0;border-radius:13px;padding:13px 19px;font-weight:700;font-size:16px;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .12s,opacity .12s}
button:active{transform:scale(.98)}
.primary{background:var(--green);color:white}
.secondary{background:#e9f2eb;color:var(--green)}
button:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}
.start-button{font-size:21px;padding:16px 34px;margin-top:14px}
.pill{display:inline-block;background:#edf6ef;color:var(--green);padding:7px 12px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;font-size:13px}
.name{font-weight:700;font-size:17px;margin:12px 0}
.topline{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:18px}
.progress{height:9px;background:#e4ece5;border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden;margin:14px 0 20px}
.progress div{height:100%;background:#2b9b67;width:0;transition:width .2s}
.timer{font-size:20px;font-weight:800;color:var(--red)}
.question{font-size:clamp(20px,3.5vw,26px);line-height:1.4;margin:18px 0}
.options{display:grid;gap:11px}
.option{background:#f7faf7;border:2px solid #e1ebe2;color:#20372c;text-align:left;line-height:1.4}
.option:hover:not(:disabled){border-color:#72b58d;background:#eff8f1}
.option.correct{background:#d9f7df;border-color:#218447;color:#13542d}
.option.wrong{background:#ffe1e1;border-color:#cf3030;color:#8f1616}
.feedback{display:none;margin:18px auto 10px;text-align:center}
.feedback img{display:block;width:min(360px,100%);margin:0 auto 8px;border-radius:14px}
.feedback-text{font-size:22px;font-weight:800}
.next-row{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin-top:18px}
.scoreboard{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin:18px 0}
.score{border-radius:16px;padding:16px;background:#f1f8f2;border:1px solid #d8e9db}
.score strong{display:block;font-size:28px;margin-top:5px}
.score.boys{background:#eef4ff;border-color:#d9e4fb}
.winner{font-size:clamp(25px,5vw,38px);font-weight:900;color:var(--green);margin:20px 0}
.teacher{margin-top:22px;border-top:1px solid #e2e9e2;padding-top:18px;line-height:1.7}
.hidden{display:none!important}
#toast{font-weight:700}
@media(max-width:540px){.scoreboard{grid-template-columns:1fr}.topline{align-items:flex-start}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<main>
<section id="start" class="panel center">
  <span class="pill">TO‘QIMACHILIK FANIDAN BILIM SINOVI</span>
  <h1>128-25-guruh talabalari</h1>
  <p class="name">Tayyorladi: Jabborov A. Mirzabdullayev O.</p>
  <p class="muted">20 ta nazariy savol. Har bir savol uchun 60 soniya beriladi. To‘g‘ri javob uchun jamoaga 1 ball yoziladi. Javobdan keyin ovoz va GIF ko‘rsatiladi.</p>
  <p class="muted">Savollar navbat bilan beriladi: toq raqamli savollar — qizlarga, juft raqamli savollar — bolalarga.</p>
  <button class="primary start-button" id="startBtn">BOSHLASH</button>
</section>

<section id="quiz" class="panel hidden">
  <div class="topline">
    <span class="pill" id="questionCount">1 / 20-SAVOL</span>
    <span class="pill" id="teamBadge">QIZLAR JAVOB BERADI</span>
    <span class="timer" id="timer">⏱ 60</span>
  </div>
  <div class="progress"><div id="progressBar"></div></div>
  <h2 id="questionTitle">Savol</h2>
  <div id="options" class="options"></div>
  <div id="feedback" class="feedback">
    <img id="reactionGif" alt="Javob reaksiyasi">
    <div id="feedbackText" class="feedback-text"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="next-row"><button class="primary" id="nextBtn" disabled>KEYINGISI →</button></div>
</section>

<section id="results" class="panel center hidden">
  <span class="pill">O‘YIN YAKUNLANDI</span>
  <h1>NATIJALAR</h1>
  <p class="muted">Yakuniy natija to‘plangan ballar asosida aniqlandi.</p>
  <div class="scoreboard">
    <div class="score"><span>👧 QIZLAR</span><strong id="girlsScore">0 ball</strong></div>
    <div class="score boys"><span>👦 BOLALAR</span><strong id="boysScore">0 ball</strong></div>
  </div>
  <div class="winner" id="winnerText"></div>
  <p id="summaryText" class="muted"></p>
  <button class="secondary" id="restartBtn">QAYTA BOSHLASH</button>
  <div class="teacher">
    <p><strong>O‘qituvchi:</strong> Valiyev Nodirbek</p>
    <p><strong>Tayyorladi:</strong> Jabborov A. Mirzabdullayev O.</p>
    <h2>TASHAKKURNOMA</h2>
    <p>Faol ishtirokingiz va e’tiboringiz uchun rahmat! Barchangizga o‘qishlaringizda omad, kelajagingizga yorqin muvaffaqiyatlar tilaymiz!</p>
  </div>
</section>
</main>
<script>
const GOOD_GIF = "data:image/gif;base64,";
const BAD_GIF = "data:image/gif;base64,";

const questions = [
{q:"To‘qimachilik tolalarini kelib chiqishi va olinishi bo‘yicha tasniflashda qaysi yondashuv ilmiy jihatdan eng to‘g‘ri?",a:["Tolalarni faqat rangi va uzunligiga qarab tabiiy hamda kimyoviy guruhlarga ajratish","Tabiiy tolalarni o‘simlik, hayvon va mineral manbalarga; kimyoviy tolalarni esa sun’iy va sintetik guruhlarga ajratish","Barcha sellyulozali tolalarni sintetik, barcha oqsilli tolalarni sun’iy deb hisoblash","Tolalarni faqat paxta va paxta bo‘lmagan guruhlarga ajratish"],c:1},
{q:"Paxta va jun tolalarining kimyoviy tabiatini taqqoslaganda qaysi fikr to‘g‘ri?",a:["Paxta asosan sellyulozadan, jun esa keratin kabi oqsilli moddadan tashkil topgan","Ikkala tola ham asosan sof sellyulozadan tashkil topgan","Paxta keratindan, jun esa regeneratsiyalangan sellyulozadan tashkil topgan","Ularning asosiy polimeri bir xil bo‘lib, farq faqat rangidadir"],c:0},
{q:"Viskoza tolasi nima sababdan sun’iy kimyoviy tola hisoblanadi?",a:["U polimeri faqat neftdan sintez qilinadi","U hayvon organizmida tabiiy ravishda hosil bo‘ladi","Tabiiy sellyuloza kimyoviy qayta ishlanib, tola shaklida qayta hosil qilinadi","U mineral kristallarni mexanik maydalash orqali olinadi"],c:2},
{q:"Poya po‘stloq-lub tolalari bilan urug‘ tolalari o‘rtasidagi asosiy farq qaysi javobda aniq ifodalangan?",a:["Poya tolalari faqat hayvonlardan, urug‘ tolalari esa minerallardan olinadi","Ular o‘simlikning turli anatomik qismlarida rivojlanadi; shu sababli tolalarning tuzilishi va texnologik xususiyatlari farqlanadi","Urug‘ tolalarida sellyuloza bo‘lmaydi, poya tolalari esa faqat oqsildan iborat","Ularning farqi faqat tayyor mahsulot rangida namoyon bo‘ladi"],c:1},
{q:"Paxta kabi sellyulozali tolani alanga ta’sirida kuzatganda qaysi belgilar majmuasi odatda kutiladi?",a:["Tola alangadan uzoqlashadi, erib shaffof munchoq hosil qiladi va o‘tkir kimyoviy hid chiqaradi","Tola qog‘ozga o‘xshash tarzda yonadi, kuygan o‘simlik qog‘ozi hidiga yaqin hid paydo bo‘ladi va kul qoldig‘i hosil bo‘ladi","Tola yonmaydi va umuman o‘zgarishsiz qoladi","Tola faqat ko‘karib, metall singari qattiq qoldiq beradi"],c:1},
{q:"Jun yoki boshqa oqsilli tolani sellyulozali toladan alanga sinovi bilan farqlashda qaysi kuzatuv ko‘proq ahamiyatga ega?",a:["Oqsilli tolalarda kuygan sochga xos hid va ko‘mirlangan qoldiq kuzatilishi mumkin; sellyulozali tolalar esa qog‘ozga o‘xshash yonadi","Har ikkala guruh ham doimo bir xil hid chiqaradi va bir xil kul beradi","Oqsilli tolalar har qanday sharoitda shaffof erigan munchoq hosil qiladi","Faqat alanga rangiga qarab tola tarkibini mutlaq aniqlash mumkin"],c:0},
{q:"Sintetik termoplastik tolani alanga ta’sirida tekshirishda qaysi holat ko‘p uchrashi mumkin, ammo barcha sintetik tolalar uchun mutlaq qoida hisoblanmaydi?",a:["Tola doimo qog‘ozdek yonib, mayin kulga aylanadi","Tola yumshashi yoki erishi, qisqarishi va sovigach qattiq tomchi hosil qilishi mumkin","Tola har doim yonishdan oldin kristallangan shakar hidini chiqaradi","Tola alanga ta’sirida hech qachon shaklini o‘zgartirmaydi"],c:1},
{q:"Paxta namligini aniqlashdan oldin namuna olish va uni saqlashda eng muhim talab qaysi?",a:["Faqat eng oq tolalarni tanlab olish","Namuna butun partiyaning xususiyatini ifodalashi va tekshiruvgacha namlik almashinuviga imkon qadar kam duch kelishi","Namunani ochiq havoda uzoq qoldirib, xona namligiga tasodifiy moslashtirish","Namuna ichidagi iflosliklarni natijaga ta’sirini hisobga olmasdan ko‘paytirish"],c:1},
{q:"Quritish usulida paxta namligini aniqlashda namunaning doimiy massaga kelganini tekshirish nima uchun muhim?",a:["Tola rangini bir xil qilish uchun","Qolgan namlik sababli quruq massa noto‘g‘ri baholanmasligini ta’minlash uchun","Tola uzunligini oshirish uchun","Namuna tarkibidagi barcha tabiiy moddalarni kuydirib yuborish uchun"],c:1},
{q:"Elektr tamoyiliga asoslangan namlik o‘lchagich ko‘rsatkichini tekshirishda qaysi yondashuv to‘g‘ri?",a:["Ko‘rsatkichni har qanday harorat va zichlikda mutlaq xatosiz deb qabul qilish","Asbob ko‘rsatkichiga harorat, namuna zichligi, kalibrlash va material xususiyatlari ta’sir qilishi mumkinligini hisobga olish","Namuna massasini o‘lchamasdan asbob natijasini barcha usullar uchun etalon deb olish","Namuna rangiga qarab namlik foizini o‘zgartirish"],c:1},
{q:"Namunaviy pilik tayyorlashda boshlang‘ich materialning bir tekis taqsimlanishi nima uchun muhim?",a:["Pilikning tashqi rangini bezash uchun","Keyingi tekshiruv natijasi tasodifiy notekislik yoki noto‘g‘ri tanlangan namuna bilan buzilmasligi uchun","Tolalarning kimyoviy tarkibini ataylab o‘zgartirish uchun","Pilikdagi barcha buramlarni yo‘qotish uchun"],c:1},
{q:"Pilik hosil qilishda cho‘zish va buram berish amallari qanday o‘zaro bog‘langan?",a:["Cho‘zish tolali oqimni ingichkalashtirib va tekislab boradi, buram esa tolalarga vaqtincha tutashuv va ishlov jarayonida yetarli mustahkamlik beradi","Buram tolalarni butunlay parallel holatdan chiqarib, cho‘zishning barcha vazifasini bekor qiladi","Cho‘zish faqat rangni o‘zgartiradi, buram esa namlikni aniqlaydi","Ikkala amal ham faqat pilik massasini oshirish uchun bajariladi"],c:0},
{q:"Natijaviy pilik sifatini baholashda faqat tashqi ko‘rinishga tayanish nima sababdan yetarli emas?",a:["Tashqi ko‘rinish hech qanday ma’lumot bermaydi","Bir xil ko‘ringan piliklarda ham chiziqli zichlik, notekislik, buram va tolalarning joylashishi bo‘yicha farqlar bo‘lishi mumkin","Pilik sifatini faqat uning rangidan to‘liq aniqlash mumkin","Natijaviy pilikda tolalar bo‘lmaydi"],c:1},
{q:"Paxta tolasining mexanik shikastlanishi deganda qaysi holat eng to‘g‘ri tushuniladi?",a:["Tolaga mexanik ishlov yoki tashqi kuch ta’sirida uning yaxlitligi buzilishi, uzilishi yoki tuzilishida nuqson paydo bo‘lishi","Tolaning tabiiy rangi har qanday o‘zgarishi","Tolada tabiiy buramdorlik mavjud bo‘lishi","Tolada muvozanat namligi yuzaga kelishi"],c:0},
{q:"Tolalardagi shikastlanish belgilarini mikroskopda baholashda qaysi yondashuv eng ishonchli?",a:["Bitta belgiga qarab barcha shikastlanish sabablarini qat’iy belgilash","Kuzatilgan shaklni namuna tayyorlash usuli, tolalarning tabiiy tuzilishi va boshqa belgilar bilan birga baholash","Faqat mikroskop kattalashtirishini yozib, tasvirni tahlil qilmaslik","Faqat tolalarning rangiga qarab mexanik shikastlanishni aniqlash"],c:1},
{q:"Paxta tolasining shikastlanishi ip yigirish xususiyatlariga qanday ta’sir ko‘rsatishi mumkin?",a:["Tola uzunligi va yaxlitligining buzilishi tolalararo tutashuvni hamda ipning mustahkamligi va uzilish barqarorligini yomonlashtirishi mumkin","Shikastlanish doimo ip mustahkamligini oshiradi","Shikastlanish faqat tayyor gazlama rangiga ta’sir qiladi","Shikastlangan tolalar texnologik jarayonda hech qanday farq tug‘dirmaydi"],c:0},
{q:"Paxta tolasining tabiiy buramdorligi qanday tuzilish xususiyati bilan bog‘liq?",a:["Tola qurishi davomida devor tuzilishi va ko‘ndalang kesimining notekis shakllanishi natijasida lenta ko‘rinishidagi tabiiy burilishlar paydo bo‘lishi bilan","Tolaga yigirish mashinasida albatta mexanik buram berilishi bilan","Tola yuzasiga bo‘yoq qatlami surtilishi bilan","Faqat tolada namlik mutlaqo bo‘lmasligi bilan"],c:0},
{q:"Buramdorlik chastotasi va buramdorlik darajasi o‘rtasidagi farq qaysi javobda to‘g‘ri ifodalangan?",a:["Chastota muayyan uzunlikdagi burilishlar sonini tavsiflaydi, daraja esa burilishlarning ifodalanganlik yoki kattalik xususiyatini tavsiflaydi","Chastota namlikni, daraja esa tola rangini bildiradi","Ikkala atama ham faqat tolaning uzunligini anglatadi","Chastota faqat jun uchun, daraja faqat sintetik tolalar uchun ishlatiladi"],c:0},
{q:"Buramdorlikning turg‘unligi nima uchun alohida ahamiyatga ega?",a:["Tola ishlov jarayonida buramdorlik xususiyatini qay darajada saqlashini ifodalaydi va tolalarning ilashuvchanligi hamda yigirish xususiyatlariga ta’sir qilishi mumkin","U faqat tola rangining vaqt o‘tishi bilan o‘zgarmasligini bildiradi","U paxta namligini bevosita foizda ko‘rsatadi","U tolani kimyoviy tarkibiga qarab tabiiy yoki sintetik deb belgilaydi"],c:0},
{q:"Paxta tolasining buramdorligi ip va gazlama xususiyatlariga qanday ta’sir ko‘rsatishi mumkin?",a:["Tolalarning o‘zaro ilashuvchanligi va ipning shakllanishiga ta’sir qilishi mumkin, biroq natija boshqa tola xususiyatlari hamda texnologik sharoitlarga ham bog‘liq","U faqat tayyor gazlamaning rangini belgilaydi va ip mustahkamligiga ta’sir qilmaydi","Buramdorlik ortishi har qanday sharoitda ip sifatini mutlaq oshiradi","Buramdorlik faqat namlik o‘lchagich ko‘rsatkichini o‘zgartiradi"],c:0}
];

let index = 0, girls = 0, boys = 0, timeLeft = 60, timerId = null, answered = false, soundCtx = null;
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
function show(id){$(id).classList.remove('hidden')}
function hide(id){$(id).classList.add('hidden')}
function playTone(type){
  try{
    soundCtx = soundCtx || new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    if(soundCtx.state === 'suspended') soundCtx.resume();
    const now = soundCtx.currentTime;
    if(type === 'good'){
      [880,1175,1568].forEach((freq,i)=>{
        const osc=soundCtx.createOscillator(), gain=soundCtx.createGain();
        osc.type='sine'; osc.frequency.value=freq;
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001,now+i*0.09);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.18,now+i*0.09+0.02);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,now+i*0.09+0.22);
        osc.connect(gain);gain.connect(soundCtx.destination);osc.start(now+i*0.09);osc.stop(now+i*0.09+0.24);
      });
    } else if(type === 'bad'){
      [260,190].forEach((freq,i)=>{
        const osc=soundCtx.createOscillator(), gain=soundCtx.createGain();
        osc.type='square';osc.frequency.value=freq;
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001,now+i*0.18);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.12,now+i*0.18+0.02);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,now+i*0.18+0.15);
        osc.connect(gain);gain.connect(soundCtx.destination);osc.start(now+i*0.18);osc.stop(now+i*0.18+0.17);
      });
    } else {
      [660,880,990].forEach((freq,i)=>{
        const osc=soundCtx.createOscillator(), gain=soundCtx.createGain();
        osc.type='triangle';osc.frequency.value=freq;
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001,now+i*0.1);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.1,now+i*0.1+0.02);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,now+i*0.1+0.18);
        osc.connect(gain);gain.connect(soundCtx.destination);osc.start(now+i*0.1);osc.stop(now+i*0.1+0.2);
      });
    }
  }catch(e){}
}
function startGame(){
  index=0;girls=0;boys=0;hide('start');hide('results');show('quiz');loadQuestion();
}
function loadQuestion(){
  clearInterval(timerId); answered=false;timeLeft=60;
  const q=questions[index];
  $('questionCount').textContent=`${index+1} / 20-SAVOL`;
  const team = index%2===0?'QIZLAR JAVOB BERADI':'BOLALAR JAVOB BERADI';
  $('teamBadge').textContent=team;
  $('questionTitle').textContent=q.q;
  $('timer').textContent='⏱ 60';
  $('progressBar').style.width=((index)/questions.length*100)+'%';
  $('feedback').style.display='none';
  $('nextBtn').disabled=true;
  $('nextBtn').textContent=index===questions.length-1?'NATIJANI KO‘RISH →':'KEYINGISI →';
  const options=$('options');options.innerHTML='';
  q.a.forEach((text,i)=>{
    const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='option';
    b.textContent=String.fromCharCode(65+i)+'. '+text;
    b.addEventListener('click',()=>chooseAnswer(i,b));
    options.appendChild(b);
  });
  timerId=setInterval(()=>{
    timeLeft--; $('timer').textContent='⏱ '+timeLeft;
    if(timeLeft<=0){clearInterval(timerId);timeoutQuestion();}
  },1000);
}
function chooseAnswer(choice, button){
  if(answered)return;
  answered=true;clearInterval(timerId);
  const q=questions[index], correct=choice===q.c;
  [...$('options').children].forEach((b,i)=>{
    b.disabled=true;
    if(i===q.c)b.classList.add('correct');
    if(i===choice && !correct)b.classList.add('wrong');
  });
  if(correct){
    if(index%2===0)girls++;else boys++;
    showFeedback(true,'TO‘G‘RI! Jamoaga 1 ball qo‘shildi.');
    playTone('good');
  }else{
    showFeedback(false,'NOTO‘G‘RI! To‘g‘ri javob: '+String.fromCharCode(65+q.c)+'. '+q.a[q.c]);
    playTone('bad');
  }
  $('nextBtn').disabled=false;
}
function showFeedback(correct,text){
  $('feedback').style.display='block';
  $('reactionGif').src=correct?GOOD_GIF:BAD_GIF;
  $('feedbackText').textContent=text;
}
function timeoutQuestion(){
  if(answered)return;
  answered=true;
  [...$('options').children].forEach(b=>b.disabled=true);
  $('feedback').style.display='block';
  $('reactionGif').src=BAD_GIF;
  $('feedbackText').textContent='⛔ VAQT TUGADI! Keyingisi tugmasini bosing.';
  playTone('bad');
  $('nextBtn').disabled=false;
}
function nextQuestion(){
  if(!answered)return;
  if(index<questions.length-1){index++;loadQuestion();}
  else showResults();
}
function showResults(){
  clearInterval(timerId);hide('quiz');show('results');
  $('progressBar').style.width='100%';
  $('girlsScore').textContent=girls+' ball';
  $('boysScore').textContent=boys+' ball';
  if(girls>boys){$('winnerText').textContent='QIZLAR G‘OLIB! 👑🔥';playTone('applause');}
  else if(boys>girls){$('winnerText').textContent='BOLALAR G‘OLIB! 🏆';playTone('applause');}
  else {$('winnerText').textContent='DURANG! 🤝';playTone('applause');}
  $('summaryText').textContent=`Qizlar: ${girls}/10 ball. Bolalar: ${boys}/10 ball.`;
}
$('startBtn').addEventListener('click',startGame);
$('nextBtn').addEventListener('click',nextQuestion);
$('restartBtn').addEventListener('click',startGame);
</script>
</body>
</html>
